Institute PALS based management of bradycardia including epinephrine bolus which precipitates VT, recognition of VT following epinephrine bolus and subsequent management of pulseless VT including cardioversion
Recognize recurrent seizure activity, ensure bezodiazepines used in management.
Receive information from nurse via external source that patient received a caudal at the end of the anesthetic procedure and hence institute treatment for local anesthetic toxicity

Before time is available to institute management of seizures recognition of inadequate ventilation with progressive desaturation
After 2 cycles of cardioversion, recognition of restoration of sinus rhythum.
